_comment: The fixed set of @/components/ui/* primitives every published module is written against (see nextapi_module_factory's builder skill_prompt.py, 'these are the only @/components/ui/* paths that actually exist on the host'). `sync` ensures every file here exists in the target project's frontend/components/ui/ before placing module files, self-healing starters (like this one) that don't ship the full canonical set yet. Do not add files here for anything module-specific - only genuinely universal shadcn/ui primitives every host is expected to provide.
